propositions: _repair_ticket calls rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log directly instead of going through rebuild_with_restore, so deleted SNAPSHOT sources are never restored during per-ticket repair.
rebuild_with_restore lacks a no_commit parameter, so routing _repair_ticket through it would cause per-ticket commits in batch repair loops that should defer all commits until after the batch.
_repair_ticket does not surface restored filenames in its disp dict, unlike repair_or_plan which reports restored sources.

The two repair entry points (_repair_ticket and repair_or_plan) behave differently due to the direct rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log call, contradicting rebuild_with_restore's docstring claiming it is the sole repair entrypoint.
rebuild_with_restore must gain keyword-only no_commit parameter forwarded to rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log so _repair_ticket can pass its own no_commit contract through unchanged.
